## Ctx.videoCaptionPayload() method

Route function for videoCaption with payload match intent `this.data.name`

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
videoCaptionPayload?(): Promise<any>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;any&gt;

## Remarks

Triggered by video with caption and with payload.
